summary.text: GiGi Hayes is the Democratic candidate for the Alabama House of Representatives, District 52, in the November 3, 2026 general election, in a race with no incumbent.

paragraphs.text: Hayes and LaTanya Millhouse advanced to a runoff after the Democratic primary on May 19, 2026, in which both defeated incumbent Kelvin Datcher.
Hayes then won the June 16, 2026, runoff with 74.9 percent of the vote.
